name: MatchConfig
doc: Cook-time feature schema. Feature order is six floats per bone (position/velocity), three root-velocity floats, then six floats per horizon (position/facing).

fields.name: clips
fields.doc: Ordered canonical source clip references; empty accepts importer-supplied bindings.

fields.name: bones
fields.doc: Ordered stable joint IDs used for pose position and velocity features.

fields.name: horizons
fields.doc: Increasing future root sample times in source clip ticks.

fields.name: step
fields.doc: Cook-time sampling interval in source ticks.

fields.name: trajectoryWeight
fields.doc: Normalized root-velocity and future-trajectory cost weight.
